company.description:
KaiPod Learning offers in-person learning pods for online learners and homeschoolers with enrichment, academic support, and socialization opportunities -- all supported by an experienced KaiPod Learning Coach.

The company was founded in 2021 by Amar Kumar and is headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts.
